question: 苹果公司2025财年营业收入比2024财年增长了百分之多少？
first_sql: SELECT a.CSNAME AS `股票名称`, a.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2025 THEN c.F048N END) / 100, 3) AS `2025财年营业收入(亿美元)`, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2024 THEN c.F048N END) / 100, 3) AS `2024财年营业收入(亿美元)`, ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2025 THEN c.F048N END) - MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2024 THEN c.F048N END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2024 THEN c.F048N END), 0) * 100, 2) AS `营业收入同比增长率(%)` FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN a JOIN VIEW_COM3103_CUM c ON a.FIU_ID = c.FIU_ID WHERE a.CSNAME LIKE '%苹果%' AND c.F056N IN (2024, 2025) AND c.F003V = 'FY' AND c.F048N IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.CSNAME, a.COMB_SYMBOL HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2024 THEN c.F048N END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN c.F056N = 2025 THEN c.F048N END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.COMB_SYMBOL LIMIT 1
